statBlock.name: Rot Troll
statBlock.description: Necrotic energy eats away at the troll and harms creatures that stand close to it.

sections.Traits: Rancid Degeneration. At the end of the troll’s turn, every creature within 5 ft. takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. Skip this damage if the troll took acid or fire damage after its previous turn ended.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

statBlock.name: Rutterkin
statBlock.description: Rutterkins hunt in mobs. Their numbers pin intruders in place, and a bite can turn a dying victim into an Abyssal Wretch.

sections.Traits: Crippling Fear. When a creature other than a demon starts its turn within 30 ft. of at least three rutterkins, it makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. If six or more rutterkins are within range, it has disadvantage. Success grants immunity to all rutterkins’ Crippling Fear for 24 hours. Failure leaves the creature frightened of the rutterkins for 1 minute and restrained while frightened this way. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect on a success.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (3d6 + 2) piercing damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save against disease or become poisoned. It can repeat the save at the end of each long rest to end the effect. If reduced to 0 HP while poisoned by the bite, it dies and immediately becomes a living Abyssal Wretch. Only Wish can undo the body’s transformation.

statBlock.name: Sacred Statue
statBlock.classification: Large construct, shares the eidolon’s alignment
statBlock.description: An eidolon animates this statue to defend a sacred site.

sections.Languages: The languages the eidolon knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Acid, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
False Appearance. A motionless sacred statue is indistinguishable from an ordinary statue.
Ghostly Inhabitant. The Eidolon leaves if the statue drops to 0 HP, if it uses a bonus action to exit, or if it is turned or forced out by an effect such as Dispel Evil and Good. It appears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the statue.
Inert. An empty statue is an object.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 43 (6d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 37 (6d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Sacred animation mechanics: When an Eidolon enters the statue’s space, it can animate the statue with Sacred Animation (Recharge 5–6) and use this block instead of its own. Page 194 lists CR 12 and 8,400 XP for the Eidolon. The statue has no separate CR or XP.

statBlock.name: Shadow Dancer
statBlock.description: This shadar-kai strikes with a bladed chain and can step through shadows between blows.

sections.Traits: Fey Ancestry. The shadow dancer has advantage on saves against being charmed, and magic cannot put it to sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Spiked Chain attacks.
Spiked Chain. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. On a failure, choose one effect. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, grapple it (escape DC 14). It is restrained while grappled, and the shadow dancer cannot grapple another target until that grapple ends. Alternatively knock the target prone or deal 22 (4d10) necrotic damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Jump. Teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied visible space. Both the starting space and the destination must be in dim light or darkness. The dancer can jump between weapon attacks made as part of another action.

statBlock.name: Sibriex
statBlock.description: A floating demon that twists living flesh. Its corrupted ground and poisonous aura make it dangerous to approach.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Contamination. Noncreature plants wither within 30 ft. of the sibriex, and the ground within that radius is difficult terrain for other creatures. A creature starting its turn there must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution save or take 14 (4d6) poison damage. Success grants immunity to that sibriex’s Contamination for 24 hours.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The sibriex can choose to succeed when it fails a saving throw.
Magic Resistance. The sibriex has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma sets the spell save DC at 21. The sibriex needs no material components.
At will. Charm Person, Command, Dispel Magic, Hold Monster.
3/day. Feeblemind.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Squirt Bile once and make three attacks in any combination of Chain and Bite.
Chain. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d12 + 7) piercing damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d8) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage.
Squirt Bile. Choose one visible creature within 120 ft. It must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity save or take 35 (10d6) acid damage.
Warp Creature. Choose up to three visible creatures within 120 ft. Each makes a DC 20 Constitution save. A creature that succeeds on this initial save becomes immune to this sibriex’s Warp Creature. A creature that fails becomes poisoned and gains one level of exhaustion. While poisoned this way, it repeats the save at the start of each of its turns. Each failure adds one level of exhaustion. Three successes end the poison and remove exhaustion from this effect. At six levels of exhaustion, the creature dies and becomes a living Abyssal Wretch under the sibriex’s control. Only Wish can undo the body’s transformation.
sections.Legendary actions:
The sibriex can spend up to 3 legendary actions between its turns and regains them at the start of its turn. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Cast a Spell (1 action). Cast one of its spells.
Spray Bile (1 action). Use Squirt Bile.
Warp (2 actions). Use Warp Creature.
sections.Flesh Warping variant:
On each failed Warp Creature save, the DM can roll d100 and apply the corresponding extra effect. It lasts until Warp Creature ends on that target or becomes permanent if the target turns into an Abyssal Wretch. A willing creature can instead remain within 30 ft. of the sibriex for at least 1 hour. It permanently gains one rolled or chosen effect.
01–05. Hair, skin, and eyes become blue, red, yellow, or patterned.
06–10. The eyes extend on stalks.
11–15. Hand claws can be used as daggers.
16–20. Uneven legs reduce walking speed by 10 ft.
21–25. Open eyes cast dim light in a 15-ft. cone.
26–30. Back wings grant a flying speed of 30 ft.
31–35. The ears tear away. The target is deafened.
36–40. Two teeth grow into tusks.
41–45. Scabbed skin raises AC by 1 and reduces Charisma by 2, to a minimum of 1.
46–50. Arms and legs trade places. The target can move only by crawling.
51–55. Tentacle arms add 5 ft. of reach.
56–60. Springy legs increase walking speed by 10 ft.
61–65. A new tail works as a whip.
66–70. Blackened eyes gain darkvision 120 ft.
71–75. The body swells to three times its weight.
76–80. The skeletal body weighs half as much.
81–85. The head doubles in size.
86–90. Wings replace the ears and grant a flying speed of 5 ft.
91–95. A brittle body grants vulnerability to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
96–100. An extra head grants advantage on saves against being charmed, frightened, or stunned.

statBlock.name: Skulk
statBlock.description: A lost traveler’s empty shell, invisible except under a few specific conditions.

sections.Traits:
Fallible Invisibility. The skulk is invisible. A mirror or other reflective surface shows it as a dull, smooth-skinned humanoid. A candle made from the rendered fat of an unidentified corpse reveals it as a dim, translucent shape. Humanoid children age 10 or younger can see it.
Trackless. The skulk leaves no tracks that reveal its path or destination.
sections.Actions: Claws. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage, plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage if the skulk had advantage on the attack roll.
sections.Summoning mechanics: A ritual can bring a skulk from the Shadowfell. When given a part of the summoner’s identity, it obeys that summoner for 30 days and vaguely resembles them when visible. It can return to the Shadowfell only when it dies.

statBlock.name: Skull Lord
statBlock.description: Three dead leaders bound into a single body command undead armies in the Shadowfell.

sections.Languages: All languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Cold, necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, stunned, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The skull lord can choose to succeed when it fails a saving throw.
Master of the Grave. Undead allies within 30 ft. have advantage on saving throws. Such an ally regains 1d6 HP when it starts its turn within range.
Evasion. When a Dexterity save would halve damage, the skull lord instead takes none on a success and half on a failure.
Undead Nature. The skull lord needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Spellcasting:
A 13th-level sorcerer using Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Chill Touch, Fire Bolt, Mage Hand, Poison Spray, Ray of Frost, Shocking Grasp.
1st level (4 slots). Magic Missile, Expeditious Retreat, Thunderwave.
2nd level (3 slots). Mirror Image, Scorching Ray.
3rd level (3 slots). Fear, Haste.
4th level (3 slots). Dimension Door, Ice Storm.
5th level (2 slots). Cloudkill, Cone of Cold.
6th level (1 slot). Eyebite.
7th level (1 slot). Finger of Death.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Bone Staff attacks.
Bone Staff. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.
sections.Legendary actions:
The skull lord can spend up to 3 legendary actions between its turns and regains them at the start of its turn. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Bone Staff (2 actions). Make one Bone Staff attack.
Cantrip (1 action). Cast a cantrip.
Move (1 action). Move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Summon Undead (3 actions). Up to five Skeletons or Zombies appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 ft. They remain until destroyed, roll initiative, and act on their next available turn. The skull lord can have at most five undead summoned this way at once.

statBlock.name: Soul Monger
statBlock.description: A shadar-kai that drains a victim’s vitality and leaves nearby creatures struggling to move.

sections.Traits:
Fey Ancestry. The soul monger has advantage on saves against being charmed, and magic cannot put it to sleep.
Magic Resistance. The soul monger has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Soul Thirst. When the soul monger reduces a creature to 0 HP, it can gain temporary HP equal to half that creature’s maximum HP. While it has temporary HP from this trait, its attack rolls have advantage.
Weight of Ages. A beast or humanoid other than a shadar-kai that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the soul monger loses 20 ft. of speed until the start of that creature’s next turn.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence sets the spell save DC at 16 and the spell attack bonus at +8. The soul monger needs no material components.
At will. Chill Touch (3d8 damage), Poison Spray (3d12 damage).
1/day each. Bestow Curse, Chain Lightning, Finger of Death, Gaseous Form, Phantasmal Killer, Seeming.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Phantasmal Dagger attacks.
Phantasmal Dagger. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (4d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 19 (3d12) necrotic damage. The target has disadvantage on saving throws until the start of the soul monger’s next turn.
Wave of Weariness (Recharge 4–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cube makes a DC 16 Constitution save. Failure deals 45 (10d8) psychic damage and adds one level of exhaustion. Success deals 22 (5d8) psychic damage.
sections.Table notes: Page 226 lists Wisdom 15 with a +3 modifier. The score of 15 normally gives +2. The Wisdom save and Perception bonus are both +7 as printed.
